acceptanceCriteria: affected does not select RSpec units under any testdata/ directory (or other declared fixture roots) of the host repository
A regression test covers a repo with a testdata Ruby fixture
body: With PR #1137 (V1-1794), corvint affected on the Corvint repo selected internal/contextindex/testdata/ruby-autoload-1130/spec/*.rb as RSpec units with scope UNKNOWN. testdata trees are fixtures, not tests of the host repository. Evidence: /private/tmp/cem10-build/rb1794-affected.json. Related to over-selection in V1-1806 but a distinct cause.
title: affected: fixture spec files under testdata are selected as RSpec test units of the host repository
